info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Customer Deposit Switches API
info.description: The Customer Deposit Switches API allows businesses to manage and retrieve deposit switch configurations for specified customers. By accessing this endpoint, developers can query the current status of a customer's deposit switches, enabling financial institutions to efficiently handle deposit preferences. Typical consumers include banking applications and financial service providers seeking real-time updates on customer deposit options. This functionality is essential for enhancing the customer experience and streamlining operational workflows.

get.summary: Retrieve deposit switches for a specific customer.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the deposit switches associated with a customer identified by their unique ID. It provides insights into the available deposit switch options for that customer, helping to manage their banking preferences effectively.
